identity: &Rubik and Smokes finish their negotiation and agree to a complex set of terms.  Caravans will begin in about a week.  Rubik offers a stiff bow over the screen before it switches to static.  Smokes leans back, offering an easy smile.  "Well, didn't expect that today - negotiations with, well, whatever they are - but that went well.  I appreciate you.  Not sure we would've come to a deal without someone to do a bit of translating."
